[[File:Giant Rock.png|thumb|250px|The Giant Rock secured in [[Lysandre Labs]]]] The '''Giant Rock''' (Japanese: '''巨石''' ''{{wp|Megalith}}'') is a powerful material in {{aniseries|XY}}. It is an ancient, giant rock that contains massive amounts of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] energy. It was later used by [[Lysandre]] to create a {{form|Zygarde|50% Forme}} {{p|Zygarde}}-like construct under his control ==History== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====Pre-series==== In the ancient times in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)|Groudon}} and Primal {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)|Kyogre}} clashed, expanding the land and seas as they tried to take possession of the incredible source of power that is the Giant Rock. At some point after that, ancient people discovered the Giant Rock and hid it away under a temple atop a mountain. Said temple being only found through the use of two [[Key Stone]]s. ===={{aniseries|XY}}==== In the ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'', [[Alain]], [[Mairin]], {{an|Steven Stone}}, and [[Lysandre]] were looking for the giant rock in ruins and thanks to the latters's [[Key Stone]]s, they found the rock within ruins atop a mountain. As Lysandre's scientists started researching on it, [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] [[Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)#Rayquaza|Rayquaza]] appeared and tried to attack them. Alain and Steven attempted to fend off the {{pkmn|category|Sky High Pokémon}}, but the Giant Rock disappeared. In the ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', the [[Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)|super-ancient Pokémon]] battled over the Giant Rock, due to being attracted to its massive amount of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] energy. While Alain and Steven fought off [[Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)#Groudon|Groudon]] and [[Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)#Kyogre|Kyogre]], Lysandre managed to secure the giant stone by blinding out Rayquaza. During the events of ''[[XYS04|Mega Evolution Special IV]]'', Chespie got hurt while saving Squishy from [[Team Flare]], causing the {{p|Chespin}} to absorb the energy around it and enter a comatose state. [[File:Giant Rock 2.png|thumb|250px|left|The Giant Rock in its {{form|Zygarde|50% Forme}} {{p|Zygarde}}-like form]] After this, the Giant Rock made a brief appearance in ''[[XY111|Unlocking Some Respect!]]'', where it was seen in [[Xerosic]]'s lab. In ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'', it was revealed that, in case Team Flare lost control of the [[Z2|two]] [[Squishy|Zygarde]], Lysandre had planned for it to absorb Chespie and transform into a copy of Zygarde, which would then collide with [[Anistar City]]'s Sundial and release enough energy to wipe out all life on the {{pkmn|world|planet}}. It was created when {{an|Serena}}, [[Mairin]], {{an|Professor Sycamore}} and {{TRT}} invaded [[Lysandre Labs]], destroying the laboratory during its conception and forcing all Team Flare agents present to flee. It could not be stopped by Ash, Alain, Steven, Professor Sycamore, Serena and their strongest Pokémon, although Ash-Greninja was able to sense Chespie's presence in the giant creature and marked its location with a {{m|Water Shuriken}}. In ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'', the {{ashfr|group}} was helped by [[Kalos]] [[Gym Leader]]s, Diantha, Meyer, and Malva. Together, they all helped clear or destroy some of the Giant Rock's roots in order to pave the way for Ash, Alain and their Pokémon to enter the Giant Rock's inner core and rescue Chespie, which deprived the Giant Rock of its power source, thus rendering it inert. Lysandre ultimately had to personally power it back up using his control device, but in response Squishy and Z2 transformed into {{form|Zygarde|Complete Forme}} Zygarde, which was able to match the Giant Rock in combat. Although Lysandre attempted to fight back, he was defeated when Ash's Greninja, Pikachu and Alain's Charizard destroyed his control device, allowing Zygarde to attack the Giant Rock with {{m|Extreme Speed}}, which made a massive hole in it. It was finally destroyed by Squishy and Z2's {{m|Core Enforcer}}, of which Lysandre was engulfed in the explosion and leaving his final fate unclear. It also appeared in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]'', during a video fantasy and a flashback. ==Characteristics== In its Zygarde form, the Giant Rock has roughly the same body shape as {{p|Zygarde}}'s {{form|Zygarde|50% Forme}}, except it is much larger. Its upper body is primarily made out of stone, with a glowing red crystal serving as its "eye", whereas its lower body is composed out of vines. These vines also serve as a defense mechanism to protect the core body from attacks. The Giant Rock is partly hollow inside, with its "innards" being composed out of glowing red crystals, with [[Chespie]], its power source, at the center. These red crystals will likewise grow and shift to serve as a defense mechanism for its energy source. Even after the power source is removed, Lysandre still managed to power it up remotely using a control device coupled to his gauntlet. Due to its vast size and mindless nature, the Giant Rock is extremely difficult to slow down, let alone defeat. In order to stop it, {{an|Steven Stone}}, [[Diantha]], {{Ash}}, [[Alain]], [[Meyer]], [[Malva]], and {{an|Professor Sycamore}}, as well as eight [[Kalos]] [[Gym Leader]]s, needed to have all their strongest Pokémon team up against it. Even then, after Lysandre powered it up again, [[Squishy]] and [[Z2]] had to transform into Zygarde Complete Forme to stop it, and only managed to do so after [[Ash's Pikachu]], {{AP|Greninja}}, and [[Alain's Charizard]] destroyed Lysandre's control device. ==Trivia== * As a Zygarde, the Giant Rock's characteristics parallel those of the [[Meta Groudon]] from ''[[M06|Jirachi: Wish Maker]]''. Both of them are artificial, corrupted, bigger versions of a {{type|Ground}} Legendary Pokémon, created by characters associating with villainous teams whose goals were to capture and control the real version. Both creatures are also mindless beasts whose sole intentions are to absorb more power. * The Giant Rock in its Zygarde form has a number of similarities with the [[ultimate weapon]]. Both are weapons powered by the energy of Pokémon channeled through special stones, are capable of firing catastrophically powerful laser beams, and are used by Lysandre in his bid to destroy and remake the world according to Team Flare's ideals only to have their power sources removed and ultimately be destroyed with Lysandre within them. ** It also shares similarities with the [[Meteonite]], being a mysterious rock that can store and unleash energy that is sought for usage as a weapon by one or more [[villainous team]]s operating in the region. ** It also shares similarities with the {{p|Heatran}}-shaped lava creature featured in [[Pokémon: The Arceus Chronicles]]. Both are created by an existing item — the original form of the Giant Rock and a [[Flame Plate]], respectively — merging with the power of a Legendary Pokémon through the actions of a villainous team. They then transform into an autonomous weapon in the shape of the legendary Pokémon whose power they fused with, and travel toward a fixed destination that will cause an apocalyptic explosion if they reach it. Both are only stopped through the intervention of a group that includes at least one {{pkmn|Champion}}, and near the end of the battle to stop them, {{Ash}} and some of {{ashfr}} enter the weapon's structure to remove the Pokémon providing its power from within. ** It also resembles [[Ange]] from {{g|Legends: Z-A}}. Both are artificial constructs that absorb a Pokémon and take on aspects of its physical appearance, are capable of unleashing giant roots and firing powerful lasers, and are both ultimately destroyed by Zygarde. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color=A1D175|bordercolor=6FB82B |da=Kempestenen |nl=Reuzensteen |fi=Jättiläiskivi |fr=Pierre Géante |de=Großer Felsen |it=Roccia Gigante |no=Kjempesteinen |pl=Wielka Skała |pt_br=Rocha Gigante ([[XY135]]-present)
